name: Paintable Indicator
description: This block has a paintable surface where small grid squares can be painted individually. Use additive painting mode to paint the backlight grid. The backlight can be enabled by using an on signal and a name can be set with the select tool that will be visible when the indicator is looked at by a player.
shortDescription: A backlit indicator for displaying painted detail.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Switches the backlight on when receiving an on signal.
